title: Home
excerpt: AI Village is a hacker-rooted public-interest AI security community for hands-on education, red-team practice, workshops, events, and open resources.
content_html:
Public-interest AI security

AI security, tested in public.

AI Village brings hackers, researchers, engineers, and policymakers together through hands-on AI security education, red-team exercises, workshops, events, and open resources.

New · DEF CON 34

HalCTF: Autonomous Agent CTF

Teams up to 5 · Models hosted

Design and deploy an AI agent that exploits sandboxed targets and captures flags on its own. Bring your code, not your GPUs.

Read the announcement

AI Village returns to DEF CON 34 in LVCC W603 with competitions, DEF CON stage sessions, poster presentations, fireside chats, and demos.

What we do

Practical AI security, built in public.

AI Village connects education, experimentation, and community practice so people can understand, test, and secure AI systems.

Red-team AI systems

Run and learn from practical exercises that expose how AI systems fail, where defenses help, and what responsible testing looks like.

Teach AI security

Publish workshops, labs, and learning material for people moving from curiosity to hands-on AI security practice.

Host community events

Bring hackers, builders, researchers, and policy-minded practitioners together at DEF CON and other community events.

Publish field notes and resources

Share technical writing, recaps, and open resources from the people doing the work.

Programs

Start where you can contribute.

Explore the major paths into AI Village: red teaming, workshops, events, and technical work.

Generative Red Team

A public red-team program focused on understanding and exercising real AI system failure modes.

Workshops & Labs

Hands-on learning material for AI security, adversarial thinking, and practical experimentation.

Events & Challenges

Find upcoming events, DEF CON activity, schedules, recaps, and community challenges.

公益人工智能安全

人工智能安全，经过公开测试。

AI Village 通过人工智能安全实践教育、红队练习、研讨会、活动和开放资源，将黑客、研究人员、工程师和政策制定者聚集在一起。

新 · DEF CON 34

HalCTF：自主代理 CTF

团队最多 5 人 · 模特主持

设计和部署一个人工智能代理，该代理可以利用沙盒目标并自行捕获标志。 带上您的代码，而不是 GPU。

我们做什么

公共构建的实用人工智能安全。

AI Village 将教育、实验和社区实践联系起来，以便人们能够理解、测试和保护人工智能系统。

红队人工智能系统

进行实际练习并从中学习，这些练习揭示了人工智能系统如何失败、防御措施在哪些方面有帮助以及负责任的测试是什么样的。

教授人工智能安全

为人们从好奇心转向实际的人工智能安全实践发布研讨会、实验室和学习材料。

举办社区活动

将黑客、构建者、研究人员和具有政策意识的从业者聚集在一起参加 DEF CON 和其他社区活动。

发布现场笔记和资源

分享技术写作、回顾和开放资源。
